name: tableau-lineage
description: Audit and explore Tableau workbooks locally: unused fields, duplicate calculations, performance findings, full lineage, filters, dashboards, stored SQL, and version diffs.
long_description:
Reads Tableau packaged workbooks (.twbx) and workbook definitions (.twb) from your own disk and answers questions about them, without the file ever leaving your machine.

Ask your assistant things like "what would break if I change [Profit Ratio]?", "which fields in this workbook is nobody using?", "why is this dashboard slow?", or "what changed between these two versions?".

Eleven read-only tools cover: an audit (unused fields with a confidence level and the reason, duplicate calculations including the same-name-different-formula case, and 15 static performance rules), full calculated-field lineage with upstream and downstream impact, parameters, filters with their per-worksheet breakdown, worksheets and dashboards, data sources including extract vs live, any SQL the workbook stores (Custom SQL, Initial SQL, stored procedures, RAWSQL), and a semantic diff between two versions.

The extension makes no network requests at all. It parses workbooks in memory on your machine and writes nothing to disk. It is MIT licensed and fully open source, so the privacy claim is verifiable rather than promised.

The same engine also runs as a free browser app at tableau-lineage.com.

tools.name: audit_workbook
tools.description: Find unused fields and parameters, duplicate calculations, and performance problems in a workbook.

tools.name: analyze_workbook
tools.description: Overview of a workbook: field counts, data sources, calculated fields by type, parameters, raw fields.

tools.name: trace_dependencies
tools.description: Trace what a field is built from and everything downstream that a change would affect.

tools.name: diff_workbooks
tools.description: Compare two versions of a workbook and report the changes that matter, with blast radius.

tools.name: list_calculated_fields
tools.description: Every calculation with its formula, type and direct dependencies.

tools.name: get_field
tools.description: One field in full detail, including everything that uses it.

tools.name: list_parameters
tools.description: Parameters with values, datatypes, allowed values, and which fields use them.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: Every filter with its kind, context status, selected values, and per-worksheet breakdown.

tools.name: list_worksheets
tools.description: Every worksheet with the fields it uses and the filters it applies.

tools.name: list_sql_queries
tools.description: Custom SQL, Initial SQL, stored procedures and RAWSQL fields, with their connections.

tools.name: get_lineage_graph
tools.description: The complete dependency graph as nodes and edges.
